title: Field Alias Policy (Active)
description: Active canonical-to-alias mappings. Canonical fields are satisfied by existing suffixed DOCX slots. Orphaned canonical mustaches should be removed (Phase F-2B).

policy.description: A canonical field has no DOCX slot but its data is already rendered via a differently-named suffixed slot. Aliasing redirects the canonical binding to the suffixed slot.
constraints: Suffixed slot must have a verified DOCX placeholder in the locked contract.
Both fields must have the same semantic type.
Alias is read-only: no new slots or bindings are created.
Do not alias if the field is also in the remove-pending set.

auditSuppression.description: Suppress CONTRACT_SLOT_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER and BINDING_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER for canonical fields listed here when the alias policy is active.
auditSuppression.condition: canonical field exists in alias map AND suffixed slot has verified DOCX placeholder

conflict.description: BM-052 fullDocumentCode is a candidate for aliasing to fullDocumentCode2. However, fullDocumentCode2 is also in the remove-pending set (RAR-001/RAR-004). These conflict: aliasing to fullDocumentCode2 would create a dependency that removal would break.
conflict.auditBehavior: Do not suppress. Do not alias. Do not remove. Keep as governance-pending until remove decision is recorded.
conflict.resolutionRequired: Form-author must decide on RAR-001/RAR-004 before this alias can be activated. If APPROVE_REMOVE: remove fullDocumentCode2 first, then alias fullDocumentCode to fullDocumentCode6 (or another existing slot). If REJECT_REMOVE: activate alias to fullDocumentCode2.
